definition.title: Find communities to market in
definition.description: A founder gives their product URL and what it does; the workflow scouts Reddit and other online communities, checks rules and engagement patterns, and returns a ranked list of places to post with suggested framing for each.

human_review.summary: Review the community fit report before posting anywhere

product_url.title: Product URL
product_url.description: The public URL of the product or landing page.

product_description.title: What the product does
product_description.description: One to three sentences describing what the product does and who it is for.

target_audience.title: Target audience (optional)
target_audience.description: Who the ideal user is, e.g. 'fashion-conscious Gen Z shoppers' or 'indie developers'.

extra_context.title: Extra context (optional)
extra_context.description: Anything that would help the scout — category, main use case, prior attempts, what flopped.
